function.name: configure_write_source
function.description: This function configures the source for writing to a bitmap frame. It sets the size, pixel format, and resolution based on the provided parameters or the source's current settings.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap frame encoder interface

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap source

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the source bitmap to use

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Pointer to the GUID for the pixel format

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the bitmap

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the bitmap

parameters.name: xres
parameters.description: The horizontal resolution of the bitmap

parameters.name: yres
parameters.description: The vertical resolution of the bitmap

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: write_source
function.description: This function writes a source bitmap to a bitmap frame encode object, optionally converting its pixel format and applying a palette.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap frame encode object where the source will be written.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap.

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a rectangle that specifies the portion of the source bitmap to write. If this parameter is NULL, the entire source bitmap is used.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID that specifies the desired pixel format of the source. If the source is not in this format, it is converted.

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: Specifies the number of bits per pixel in the source bitmap.

parameters.name: need_palette
parameters.description: Specifies whether a palette needs to be applied to the source bitmap.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Specifies the width of the source bitmap.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Specifies the height of the source bitmap.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, and an error code on failure.

function.name: stream_getsize
function.description: This function gets the size of a stream.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream whose size is to be determined.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the size of the stream will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the function returns S_OK.

function.name: stream_read
function.description: This function reads data from a stream into a buffer

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The stream to read from

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: The buffer to read data into

parameters.name: read
parameters.description: The number of bytes to read

parameters.name: bytes_read
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the number of bytes actually read will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or the error code

function.name: stream_seek
function.description: This function seeks to a new position in a stream.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream to seek.

parameters.name: ofs
parameters.description: Offset to seek from the origin.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin from where to seek.

parameters.name: new_position
parameters.description: Pointer to store the new position in the stream after seeking.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: stream_write
function.description: This function writes a specified number of bytes from a buffer to a stream.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The stream to which the data is written.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: The buffer from which the data is taken.

parameters.name: write
parameters.description: The number of bytes to write.

parameters.name: bytes_written
parameters.description: A pointer to a ULONG where the number of actually written bytes will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If the operation failed, it returns a failure code.
